limitations_note: This brief records performance on a single, time-boxed scenario. It does NOT claim the candidate can handle every variant of this problem, nor does it measure soft skills, domain expertise beyond the scenario scope, or long-term job performance. Tier A evidence is auto-verified and capped at 'Working'; 'Strong' always requires independent human review (Tier B+). The system raises the cost of faking until honest practice is the cheapest route — it does not claim to be unfakeable.
